summary: Genasys Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Second Amendment to its Term Loan and Security Agreement, extending the maturity date from May 13, 2026 to July 13, 2026, in exchange for a 1% extension fee on the outstanding principal. The filing also includes a press release for fiscal Q2 2026 results. The amendment involves standard representations, covenants, and events of default; no price per share or premium is mentioned as this is a debt modification, not a change-of-control or capital structure event. This is a routine debt extension and earnings release, not a special situation.
